creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Fencil decision pane-headers (owner-nodded, 2026-11-08), drawn on the window board of the Lectern page muster-ui-redesign.

Each pane gets a header with its chord, state icon, callsign, name, directory, state word and time held, and context bar. Blocked and stuck headers are tinted, as the agent list's rows are. A split then says which agent is which without the sidebar.

- Panes stay flush, with today's divider and no gaps or rounded corners between them. The mock-up's gaps cost space the owner wants for text, and headers do not need them, so a header costs only its own height, about one line.
- The border marks only the pane the keyboard reaches; the state-colored border goes. docs/architecture.md describes that border legend and changes with it.
- Colors come from the color card beside this one (decision chrome-colors): the header is the pane's background shifted toward its foreground.
- No setting turns headers off. The owner may want one after using them; build it then, not ahead of his verdict.
title: Pane headers carry chord, state and directory; panes stay flush; the border marks only focus
